# NMG to Connect with Stakeholders Across the Battery Value Chain at Battery Show North America 2026


5 October 2026 -


[Matawinie](https://nmg.com/category/matawinie/) ,[Event](https://nmg.com/category/event/) ,[Investing](https://nmg.com/category/investing/) ,[Bécancour](https://nmg.com/category/becancour/)


*The Company will engage with industry leaders, customers and partners to discuss the advancement of its vertically integrated strategy, product portfolio and R&D initiatives.*


Nouveau Monde Graphite is pleased to participate in The Battery Show North America 2026 from October 12 to 15, one of North America’s leading advanced battery & EV event. Held in Detroit, a strategic hub for the automotive, energy and advanced manufacturing sectors, the event brings together key industry stakeholders, including suppliers, executives, engineers and innovators from across the value chain.


During the event, NMG (booth #4638) will connect with industry leaders, customers and partners to discuss the advancement of its vertically integrated strategy, product portfolio, R&D initiatives and opportunities to strengthen the North American supply chain through new strategic collaborations.


[REGISTER HERE](https://www.thebatteryshow.com/)


## **Graphite: A Key Material for Battery and Advanced Technology Markets**


As graphite is the largest component of a lithium-ion battery by weight, NMG is developing a fully integrated graphite value chain, from ore to refined graphite, to meet the needs of today’s and tomorrow’s industries, particularly in the energy, battery, and advanced technology sectors.


As battery demand continues to expand beyond electric vehicles and energy storage emerges as a major demand driver, securing reliable, local, and responsible battery material supply chains has become a strategic priority. Through the development of local graphite production and processing capacity, NMG is helping strengthen the resilience and reliability of the North American supply chain while supporting the growth of the battery ecosystem.


## **Meet Our Team in Detroit**


With construction of the Matawinie Mine underway and key activities advancing toward a targeted final investment decision in the upcoming months for the 13ktpy Bécancour Battery Material Plant, NMG continues to execute its strategy to develop one of the first fully integrated natural graphite production platforms in the G7.


Whether you are looking for battery material sourcing solutions, technical information, or collaboration opportunities, our team will be pleased to meet with you and discuss how we can work together.


Contact us to obtain NMG’s exclusive registration link.


[REGISTER HERE](https://www.thebatteryshow.com/)
